note: 21 opening categories adapted with original prompts and visual/evidence guidance. Choose a suitable category; do not combine all 21 or treat a formula as a performance guarantee. Patterns are writing prompts, not verified claims.

hooks.name: The Statistic
hooks.pattern: Introduce a verified number and explain why it matters to this viewer.
hooks.proof: A dated primary source with denominator and context.
hooks.visual: Show the actual data or a correctly scaled sourced chart.
hooks.avoid: Invented numbers, missing denominators, or unrelated comparisons.

hooks.name: Someone Else's Result
hooks.pattern: Introduce an attributable outcome, then investigate the method and its limits.
hooks.proof: A named, attributable case and permission for any private material.
hooks.visual: Show cleared evidence of that actual outcome.
hooks.avoid: Implying everyone will obtain the same result.

hooks.name: The Mistake
hooks.pattern: Show a recognizable error and promise a practical correction.
hooks.proof: A reproducible example demonstrating the error.
hooks.visual: Reveal the problem in the actual process before its correction.
hooks.avoid: Accusing all viewers of a problem without evidence.

hooks.name: Contrarian Flip
hooks.pattern: Question a familiar recommendation using a specific counterexample.
hooks.proof: The original advice and evidence for a bounded counterexample.
hooks.visual: Compare the recommendation with an observed alternative.
hooks.avoid: Provocation without a credible explanation.

hooks.name: The Reveal
hooks.pattern: Offer a useful artifact and make its first meaningful detail visible promptly.
hooks.proof: The actual artifact that will be shown.
hooks.visual: Begin revealing the real artifact instead of describing a future reveal.
hooks.avoid: Withholding the entire promised result until the end.

hooks.name: The Superlative
hooks.pattern: Present an exceptional option within a precisely defined comparison.
hooks.proof: A defensible comparison set, method, and limitations.
hooks.visual: Show the compared options and the measured distinction.
hooks.avoid: Unsupported best, fastest, cheapest, or only claims.

hooks.name: The Clock
hooks.pattern: Set a realistic time window for the explanation or demonstration.
hooks.proof: A timed script or real demonstration fitting that window.
hooks.visual: Start the task immediately; use a timer only if it measures the stated task.
hooks.avoid: Confusing tutorial length with the time a user needs to do the task.

hooks.name: I Tried It
hooks.pattern: Introduce an experiment that was actually performed and the question it tested.
hooks.proof: The experiment record, conditions, and observed outcome.
hooks.visual: Show a real step or result from the experiment.
hooks.avoid: Inventing personal experience or a test that was never run.

hooks.name: The Question
hooks.pattern: Ask a concrete audience question that the video will answer.
hooks.proof: Audience research helps; any factual premise still needs checking.
hooks.visual: Show the thing that makes the question understandable.
hooks.avoid: A question too vague to answer in this video.

hooks.name: Before and After
hooks.pattern: Show two genuine states and explain the change between them.
hooks.proof: Both source states and a truthful account of what changed.
hooks.visual: Match framing or use a labeled comparison so the difference is visible.
hooks.avoid: Changing unrelated conditions to exaggerate the improvement.

hooks.name: The Teardown
hooks.pattern: Introduce a real artifact or process and explain what the analysis will uncover.
hooks.proof: The inspected artifacts and the analysis method.
hooks.visual: Inspect one meaningful detail in the actual material.
hooks.avoid: Generalizing from a small sample without saying so.

hooks.name: The Stack
hooks.pattern: Connect two specific tools or methods to a demonstrable result.
hooks.proof: Confirmed capabilities, access, cost, and compatibility of both parts.
hooks.visual: Show the real handoff between the two tools or methods.
hooks.avoid: Claiming an integration exists because two names sound compatible.

hooks.name: The Warning
hooks.pattern: Explain a real consequence the viewer can meaningfully avoid.
hooks.proof: A relevant documented risk with its scope and likelihood.
hooks.visual: Show the failure or setting accurately without exaggerating danger.
hooks.avoid: Manufactured fear or trivial stakes presented as a crisis.

hooks.name: The List
hooks.pattern: Promise a counted set of distinct, useful points.
hooks.proof: The body must contain the promised count; individual claims need evidence.
hooks.visual: Establish the set clearly and demonstrate its first useful item.
hooks.avoid: Padding the list or changing the count during editing.

hooks.name: The Receipt
hooks.pattern: Lead with a real record or artifact, then explain its meaning.
hooks.proof: An authentic, cleared record with enough context to interpret it.
hooks.visual: Display the source legibly, with private details removed.
hooks.avoid: A fabricated screenshot or an assertion presented as proof.

hooks.name: The Insider
hooks.pattern: Explain an overlooked documented mechanism or a genuine authorized experience.
hooks.proof: A public authoritative source or authorized firsthand account.
hooks.visual: Point to the actual mechanism, setting, or document.
hooks.avoid: Pretending to possess privileged access or hidden knowledge.

hooks.name: The Impossible Claim
hooks.pattern: Introduce a surprising but reproducible capability and begin demonstrating it.
hooks.proof: A real demonstration plus costs, dependencies, and limits.
hooks.visual: Show the first observable proof immediately.
hooks.avoid: Removing important constraints to make the claim sound stronger.

hooks.name: The Comparison
hooks.pattern: Compare named alternatives on criteria that matter to the audience.
hooks.proof: Comparable inputs, documented criteria, and actual observations.
hooks.visual: Use aligned views or a clear comparison graphic.
hooks.avoid: Inventing a winner when the evidence supports tradeoffs.

hooks.name: The Origin
hooks.pattern: Trace how a real object, practice, or result came to exist.
hooks.proof: Source material supporting the origin story.
hooks.visual: Connect an early artifact with its later state.
hooks.avoid: Inventing history, memories, or causal links.

hooks.name: The Deadline
hooks.pattern: Explain a verified dated change and what the viewer should do about it.
hooks.proof: A current authoritative announcement and an exact date/timezone when relevant.
hooks.visual: Show the real announcement and its practical effect.
hooks.avoid: False urgency or an old deadline presented as current.

hooks.name: The Direct Address
hooks.pattern: Name a specific audience situation and offer an appropriate outcome.
hooks.proof: Confirm the offer fits that audience; check any factual claim.
hooks.visual: Show a situation or task that the intended viewer recognizes.
hooks.avoid: Overly broad targeting or invented personal knowledge about the viewer.
